'''Walt Brennorn''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Aligned with a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who rose in the wake of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] death, Brennorn staged [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] attacks on neighboring [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]]. Brennorn then announced he would establish a militia to protect them from attacks, as long as the farms paid dues of four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="MEAS" />
